WITH eligible_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.XCL_034
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results r ON r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
    JOIN races ra ON ra.XCL_065 = r.XCL_074
    JOIN circuits c ON c.XCL_001 = ra.XCL_068
    WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985'
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'Silverstone Circuit'
      AND r.XCL_079 = 2
),
lap_seconds AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.XCL_044,
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(lt.XCL_047, 1, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + 
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') + 1, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, '.') - INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + 
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) AS time_in_seconds
    FROM lapTimes lt
    WHERE lt.XCL_047 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    d.XCL_038,
    d.XCL_039,
    AVG(ls.time_in_seconds) AS avg_fastest_lap_time
FROM eligible_drivers ed
JOIN drivers d ON d.XCL_034 = ed.XCL_034
JOIN lap_seconds ls ON ls.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034
GROUP BY d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039;
